3. Sounds Test (Optional) You may test the hardware-generated sounds by starting a game and proceeding as follows: Engine Rumble (Idle}: Should be heard as soon as start button is pushed. Engine Rumble (Active): Pushing both control handles forward should cause an increase in pitch. Releasing control handles should cause engine rumble to return to idle.
Loud Shot: Press the fire button.
Loud Explosion: Heard when you get hit, indicated by cracked windshield.
Soft Explosion: Is heard when you hit an enemy tank or another object.
